name: bug-fix
summary: Reproduce a defect, gate it, fix it under the gate, then prove the fix.

steps.title: Confirm the defect is real before you touch anything
steps.run: hexa verify "<the claim that names the defect>"
steps.done_when: The verdict is CONFIRMED. A REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE verdict stops the playbook here.

steps.title: Name every consumer of the file you are about to change
steps.done_when: You have the list, and you have grepped for what the graph cannot see: crate-root re-exports and feature-gated imports.

steps.title: Write the gate before the fix, not from it
steps.run: hexa loop gate '<command that fails now and passes after>'
steps.done_when: The command is recorded and it exits non-zero today. A gate that already passes proves nothing.

steps.title: Make the fix under the gate
steps.run: hexa do run "<the fix>" --file <path> --evidence '<command that must exit 0>'
steps.done_when: The evidence command exits 0 and the change is committed.

steps.title: Hunt for what the fix missed
steps.done_when: The adversarial pass reports its findings and every accepted fix still holds the gate.

steps.title: Grade the shape you leave behind
steps.done_when: The grade is at or above where it was before you started.
